record.paper_title: Open problems in the Kontsevich graph construction of Poisson bracket symmetries
record.original_question: Can one construct smooth-atlas globalisations of the known Kontsevich infinitesimal symmetries Q_{1:6/2}(P)=O→r(γ_3)(P), Q_5(P)=O→r(γ_5)(P), and Q_7(P)=O→r(γ_7)(P)? In this notation, O→r is the graph-orientation map that sends a graph cocycle γ to a universal infinitesimal symmetry Q(P) of Poisson bi-vectors.

evidence.quote: Problem 2. Find the smooth-atlas globalisation(s) of the Kontsevich symmetries Q1: 6/2(P) = O→r(γ3)(P), Q5(P) = O→r(γ5)(P), and Q7(P) = O→r(γ7)(P), found in [2], [7], and [4] respectively.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $P$ be a Poisson bi-vector on a smooth manifold $M$. In the Kontsevich graph calculus, an unoriented graph cocycle $\gamma$ (with respect to the vertex-expanding differential in Kontsevich's graph complex) determines, via the orientation map $\mathcal{O}\vec{r}$, a universal infinitesimal deformation $Q(P)=\mathcal{O}\vec{r}(\gamma)(P)$ of Poisson structures: on every affine chart, $\dot P = Q(P)$ preserves the Jacobi identity to first order in the deformation parameter. Among the well-known cocycles in this family are:
- the tetrahedron $\gamma_3$ (Kontsevich), giving the flow $Q_{1:6/2}(P) = \mathcal{O}\vec{r}(\gamma_3)(P)$;
- the pentagon-wheel cocycle $\gamma_5$, giving $Q_5(P) = \mathcal{O}\vec{r}(\gamma_5)(P)$;
- the heptagon-wheel cocycle $\gamma_7$, giving $Q_7(P) = \mathcal{O}\vec{r}(\gamma_7)(P)$.

These flows are constructed in affine coordinates on $\mathbb{R}^d$, using polynomial differential operators in the components of $P$.

Problem. For each of the three Kontsevich infinitesimal symmetries
$$Q_{1:6/2}(P) = \mathcal{O}\vec{r}(\gamma_3)(P), \qquad Q_5(P) = \mathcal{O}\vec{r}(\gamma_5)(P), \qquad Q_7(P) = \mathcal{O}\vec{r}(\gamma_7)(P),$$
construct a smooth-atlas globalisation: produce a well-defined infinitesimal deformation $\dot P = \tilde Q(P)$ of Poisson bi-vectors on an arbitrary smooth Poisson manifold $(M,P)$, given by an explicit recipe on each chart together with correction terms compatible with smooth coordinate changes, such that the resulting deformation agrees with the affine formula in any affine atlas and preserves the Jacobi identity (modulo the deformation parameter squared) globally on $M$.
artifact.category_tag: Kontsevich graph complex and Poisson geometry
artifact.status_search_result: No published construction of smooth-atlas globalisations of the Kontsevich graph-cocycle symmetries $Q(\gamma_3)$, $Q(\gamma_5)$, $Q(\gamma_7)$ on general smooth Poisson manifolds appears in the literature. Although globalisation techniques for Kontsevich's star product are known (Cattaneo–Felder–Tomassini, Dolgushev), and recent work (e.g. Buring–Kiselev) extends the affine-chart formulas including for $\gamma_7$, the explicit smooth-atlas globalisation of these specific symmetries seems to remain unresolved.

status_evidence.title: On the Globalization of Kontsevich's Star Product and the Perturbative Poisson Sigma Model
status_evidence.snippet: Globalization of Kontsevich's star product to smooth Poisson manifolds via Poisson sigma model techniques.
status_evidence.claim: Globalisation techniques exist for the star product but not specifically for the graph-cocycle infinitesimal symmetries $Q(\gamma_{2\ell+1})$.

status_evidence.title: Poisson brackets symmetry from the pentagon-wheel cocycle in the graph complex
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of the symmetry $Q_5(P)$ from $\gamma_5$ on affine manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: The flows $Q(\gamma_3), Q(\gamma_5), Q(\gamma_7)$ are constructed in affine coordinates; smooth-manifold globalisation is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Kontsevich graphs act on Nambu-Poisson brackets
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work (2024) on actions of Kontsevich graph cocycles on Poisson/Nambu structures.
status_evidence.claim: Recent activity continues on graph-cocycle deformations, but a smooth-atlas globalisation of $Q(\gamma_3),Q(\gamma_5),Q(\gamma_7)$ has not been reported.
